name: DomainException
description: Exception thrown if a value does not adhere to a defined valid data domain. For example, it might be an invalid value for a class property and not its type.
code:
<?php
function renderImage($imageResource, $imageType)
{
  switch ($imageType) {
  case 'jpg':
  case 'jpeg':
    header('Content-type: image/jpeg');
    imagejpeg($imageResource);
    break;
  case 'png':
    header('Content-type: image/png');
    imagepng($imageResource);
    break;
  default:
    throw new DomainException('Unknown image type: ' . $imageType);
    break;
  }
  imagedestroy($imageResource);
}
?>

citations.name: Custom Exceptions in PHP: Building Your Own Error Handling System
